:::{#thm-quadratic-form}

#### Derivative of a quadratic form

For a quadratic form
(see [quadratic form](linear-algebra.qmd#def-quadratic-form)),
if $\matr{S}$ is a symmetric $p \times p$ matrix that is constant with respect to $\vb$, then:

$$
\underbrace{\deriv{\vb} (\tp{\vb} \matr{S} \vb)}_{p \times 1} = \underbrace{2 \matr{S} \vb}_{p \times 1}
$$

:::
